mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 56 degrees with dense drizzle near Harriet Park and a waxing crescent moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Overnight, temperatures will drop to 46 degrees with rain expected.

The City of Verona has recently overhauled its zoning and sign ordinance, and residents can now use an interactive map on the city website to look up their specific zoning district. Additionally, the city reminds everyone to double check their polling location on the My Vote Wisconsin website before heading out to vote, as new locations were added in 2023.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today you can visit Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy ART House 360, or play Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee have live music starting tomorrow, and you can catch the Dane County Farmer's Market on the Square this Saturday.

Regarding local safety, on October 7, an incident occurred on Basswood Avenue where a 17-year-old on an electric motorcycle collided with a turning vehicle; the juvenile's parent was cited for allowing an unauthorized minor to operate the device.
Culver's is currently closed for the night. You missed out on the Really Reese's flavor of the day, but you can head back tomorrow at 10:30 AM to try the Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough.
